author: NASS
description:
I colorized, restored, and created a soundtrack for these images of London from the late 1940s, offering a unique glimpse into the city’s streets, landmarks, and daily life. These images feature Hyde Park, street markets, a hat shop, St. Paul’s Cathedral, Parliament, the Thames, the bustling riverbanks, and more. 

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to HD
• Manual color corrections 
• Classical restoration workflows (AviSynth ) combined with modern tools for (60fps, stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring )
• Sound design created for immersive atmosphere

B&W Video Source: Producer, British Information Service, US National Archives and Records Administration, Internet Archive
